about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

caBack is initialised to the no-op lambda `() -> { }` at its declaration and this program (no COMMAREA, no LINK back) never assigns it, so deleting the reset or a caBack.run() call runs the same empty lambda.

handlers.clear() empties a map that this program never fills: it has no HANDLE CONDITION, IGNORE CONDITION or HANDLE ABEND, so handlers is empty at entry on every task and deleting the clear leaves it empty.

Deleting the store into EIBTRNID / EIBTASKN: PCIMMS reads neither (the paragraph's statements are RETURN IMMEDIATE, two MOVEs of WS-RESP / WS-RESP2 and WRITEQ TS of WS-SLOG), and nothing in the runtime reads the EIB image, so no event, output or abend depends on them.

The switch over task.aid() has only a `default -> { }` arm (PCIMMS has no HANDLE AID), so whichever string the ternary yields the switch does nothing; the flipped test only changes the string switched on.

The ca instanceof ladder and the calen == 0 / eibCalen(link area) step only compute calen, a pure function (DetCics.eibCalen reads task.eibcalen() or the given size), and calen's only use is the store into EIBCALEN. PCIMMS has no COMMAREA and no statement reads EIBCALEN, and no runtime code reads that field, so a flipped branch changes a value nobody reads. The LINK scenarios (link-4, link-20, link-1000-noterm) and the started-task scenarios held every one of them.
